_doc: Regression contract for this package's public test suites: every entry was RE-RUN
and observed against the current tree. The acceptance criterion is that each
`assert` string still appears verbatim in the check's output. `counts` is the
machine-readable form the pytest wrapper in tests/test_gate.py asserts on;
`assert` is what a human greps for. `track` says which half of the gate a check
belongs to: substrate needs nothing but this package, defended needs the COBRA
extra, engine lives in the COBRA/HTTP-proxy trees.
The suite identifiers below (S1-S9) are the current, public numbering: 101 unique
tasks across 9 suites (S1 26, S2 24, S3 15, S4 18, S5 11, S6 11, S7 10, S8 10, S9 5;
membership overlaps by design and is never summed for the unique-task count).

checks.note: Runs the REAL interpreter and the REAL branch hook, not a model of them: the component under test is `cobra.pab.hook.on_branch_entry`, so a modelled hook would certify itself (the `oracle_s5` discipline). Each cell also observes the component directly — A5 writes one constraint document per transition, A4 exactly one for the whole run — and asserts, in the same cell as the block, that no honest row was collaterally blocked.

New in Phase 9. Runs the REAL interpreter and the REAL branch hook over plans three and four levels deep — the component is `cobra.pab.hook._merge_constraints`, the root-to-leaf composition, which no task in the first 100 could exercise because every one of them branches once. Each cell also observes the component directly: A5's widest state carries one pin per granting level on the path, A4's carries the one pin the active arm wrote, and the interpreter is asserted to have reached the declared depth so nothing below is vacuous.

New in Phase 11. Drives the real site, the real HTTP proxy addon and (for the one MCP task) real MCP proxy, with no LLM, over TWO EXECUTOR MODELS rather than two arms: `bound` issues the plan's own trace, `steered` issues the trace the lure asks for. C1's four tasks are certified in both directions like every other suite (A5 refuses the off-plan target with brh_endpoint / mcp_proxy_tool while the honest steps still land, A4 admits it once the plan is amended). C2-C4's six are certified as `structural gap`: the deviation is made of on-plan targets, so nothing fires and the cell records that fact instead of pretending a defence acted. The `bound`/attack cell is what separates 'the plan was followed' from 'the lure was never delivered'.
